title: Independent Blind Reviewer Discrimination Calibration
scope: Reviewer reliability at the H8 human-review boundary; this addendum does not change UTQR-12 episode scores.
concrete_failure_scenario: Two reviewers assign 5/5 to every trajectory, mark every item acceptable, and provide minimally valid turn notes. The original aggregation schema can regard all 105 primary items as passing even though neither reviewer distinguishes a result-presuming rationale, a wrong EvidenceAtom citation, or a menu-only router from a grounded trajectory.
why_schema_types_and_ordinary_tests_are_: CSV completeness, numeric ranges, note length, turn references, and inter-reviewer agreement prove only that forms were filled consistently. They cannot show that a reviewer is sensitive to evidence-semantic defects; perfect agreement can be two correlated rubber stamps.
design_lineage: behavioral attention checks: embed known-response items without exposing their identities
contrast-set evaluation: use minimal edits that preserve most surface form while changing validity
process supervision: calibrate sensitivity to intermediate reasoning defects rather than final stop alone
signal detection: require both negative sensitivity and clean-control specificity

single_defect_families.defect: The rationale states a tool result as fact before executing the tool.
The post-measurement rationale cites a different visible EvidenceAtom while leaving the action sequence intact.
The next rationale explicitly preserves the pre-measurement belief independently of the fresh observation.
The tool is selected from eligibility or workflow position without naming a discriminating evidence question.
A challenge is broadened to an independent invariant field.
Situation-specific reasoning is replaced by one repeated legal-step template.
The semantic clue is removed and the same action is justified only by the control surface.
A turn records an observation but does not connect it to a field, belief, or downstream decision.

per_item_detection.clean_control: visible_hard_failure=false, accept_for_sft=true, and all eight dimensions >=4
per_item_detection.negative_sentinel: visible_hard_failure=true or accept_for_sft=false, and the expected dimension <=3

aggregation_contract: Reviewer A and Reviewer B are calibrated independently before their primary quality estimates are trusted.
Adjudication cannot repair a reviewer's calibration result; reliability is measured from the original independent scores.
Calibration items are excluded from per-dataset acceptance, Wilson intervals, P10, UTQR C9, and SFT export.
If either reviewer fails calibration, primary scores may be retained diagnostically but H8 does not pass.
claim_boundary: Passing calibration shows that the reviewers discriminate these known visible defects. It does not prove that primary trajectories are good, that the rubric generalizes to every defect, or that a trained student gains evidence reasoning.
